import sys

def main():
    n, k, l, r, sall, sk = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split())
    
    top_scores = [r] * k
    remaining_sk = sk - k * r
    i = k - 1
    
    while remaining_sk < 0:
        diff = min(r - top_scores[i], -remaining_sk)
        top_scores[i] -= diff
        remaining_sk += diff
        i -= 1
    
    bottom_sum = sall - sk
    bottom_scores = [l] * (n - k)
    remaining_bottom_sum = bottom_sum - (n - k) * l
    i = n - k - 1
    
    while remaining_bottom_sum > 0:
        diff = min(r - bottom_scores[i], remaining_bottom_sum)
        bottom_scores[i] += diff
        remaining_bottom_sum -= diff
        i -= 1
    
    print(*(top_scores + bottom_scores))

main()
